header: Create an Application Filter Based on Custom Tags
content:
STEP 1 |
Create a custom tag and apply to App-IDs.
1.
(Optional) Remove tags from an application.
2.
Filter or search for applications, then select the specific applications to remove tags.
3.
Edit Tags and select the tags to remove.
4.
Click OK.
PAN-OS® Administrator’s Guide 10.0 (EoL)

App-ID
STEP 2 |
Create an application filter using one or more tags.
If you select more than one tag, applications must match both tags to be included in the filter.
STEP 3 |
Create a security policy rule and Add your new application filter on the Application tab.
STEP 4 |
Commit your changes.
